job.title: Job Application for SAP Lead/Hybris developer at Valtech

tailoring.headline: SAP Lead/Hybris Developer | Senior SAP Commerce Cloud Engineer with 5+ years in Java & Spring
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years delivering, extending and maintaining enterprise e-commerce platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, micro-services, and end-to-end PIM/ERP/MDM integrations. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker/Kubernetes deployments, performance tuning and techno-functional analysis within Agile international teams.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

keywords_missing: SAP Commerce Cloud extensions for Marketing Cloud

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Lead/Hybris developer
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Valtech’s reputation for creating cutting-edge digital commerce experiences. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in designing, developing and maintaining high-performance e-commerce platforms.

bullets.label: Technical Design
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented backend modules on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java, Spring and Spring Boot, delivering robust product and catalog management.

bullets.label: API Development
bullets.text: I built and exposed OCC REST web services and headless APIs for storefronts and third-party consumers, ensuring seamless integration with PIM, ERP and MDM systems.

bullets.label: Integration & Data Pipelines
bullets.text: I engineered PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub, and resolved integration bottlenecks across SAP ERP and MDM, improving data consistency.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & CI/CD
bullets.text: I executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2) with Docker and Kubernetes, and mentored junior developers in an international Scrum team.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany, I hold a valid German residence and work permit, am serving notice until 15 December 2026 and can start 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Valtech.

tailoring.why_company: Valtech’s focus on innovative, data-driven commerce solutions aligns perfectly with my passion for building scalable SAP Commerce Cloud platforms. I admire Valtech’s commitment to digital transformation, its collaborative culture across Europe, and its track record of delivering award-winning e-commerce experiences for global brands. Joining Valtech would let me apply my techno-functional expertise to help clients achieve market-leading digital growth.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to join Valtech to combine my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise with its forward-thinking digital commerce projects, delivering high-impact solutions for leading brands.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years at Rockwell and Shell. I’m eager to bring my Java, Spring and integration experience to Valtech’s e-commerce team. Could we discuss the SAP Lead/Hybris role?
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the SAP Lead/Hybris Developer position at Valtech. With over five years of hands-on experience on SAP Commerce Cloud for Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am confident I can contribute to your innovative e-commerce initiatives.

I look forward to the possibility of discussing my fit for the role.

Best regards
